_note: Category -> ruling map. Deterministic code applies these; the model only categorizes items. Modeled on IRS Publication 502. Demo use only, not tax advice.

dental.reason: Dental treatment is a qualified medical expense.

vision.reason: Vision care and corrective lenses are qualified medical expenses.

prescriptions.reason: Prescription medications are qualified medical expenses.

otc-medical.reason: OTC medicines and first-aid supplies are eligible (post-CARES Act).

lab-diagnostics.reason: Lab tests and diagnostics are qualified medical expenses.

copays-deductibles.reason: Patient copays, coinsurance and deductibles are eligible.

medical-equipment.reason: Medical equipment and supplies (incl. SPF 15+ sunscreen) are eligible.

therapy-mental-health.reason: Medical mental-health care is a qualified expense.

massage-bodywork.reason: Massage therapy requires a Letter of Medical Necessity from a physician.

gym-fitness.reason: General fitness is not a qualified medical expense without an LMN.

cosmetic.reason: Cosmetic procedures are excluded under IRS rules.

general-wellness.reason: General wellness items are not qualified medical expenses.

food-grocery.reason: Food and groceries are not qualified medical expenses.
